worked_solution:
Let $u=3-{x}^{5}.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-5{x}^{4}\,⟹\,-\frac{7}{5}\text{d}u=7{x}^{4}\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{7{x}^{4}}{{(3-{x}^{5})}^{6}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{{(3-{x}^{5})}^{6}}\cdot 7{x}^{4}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{{u}^{6}}\cdot (-\frac{7}{5})\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{7}{5}\int \frac{1}{{u}^{6}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{7}{5}(-\frac{1}{5{u}^{5}})+C \\  & =\frac{7}{25{u}^{5}}+C \\  & =\frac{7}{25(3-{x}^{5})^{5}}+C\end{aligned}
$$
